$schema: see scripts/site-assets.mjs — every field is documented there
$comment: The site's pictures, declared — WP-94b. `node scripts/site-assets.mjs` takes
every one of them from the running product against a fixture population, on
the pinned demo clock, and writes them to docs/media/site/.
A crop rectangle is in CSS pixels of the 1600x1000 stage, measured from the
top left of the page. A still is captured at device scale 2, so the file is
twice the rectangle; `width` is what it is finally written at, which is the
widest the page ever shows the picture, doubled, and never more.
Nothing here is a mockup. An asset a fixture cannot reach is reported by the
run and left out of the site; it is never staged by hand.
